h: Theme park next door and codebreakers nearby
p: The Dinosaur and Farm Park is a gentle, outdoor day out, so it's worth packing for all weathers. Wellies or sturdy shoes, a waterproof and sun cream all have their place, sometimes on the same day. Bring a picnic and plenty of drinks, as you'll want to take your time wandering the grounds and spotting the dinosaurs.

It sits right next door to Gulliver's Land, the group's theme park in Milton Keynes, which has rides and attractions aimed at younger children. Some families like to pair the two for a longer stay, so check what's open on your dates. Milton Keynes is also home to Bletchley Park, where the codebreakers of the Second World War cracked enemy codes; older children and adults will find it fascinating.

Willen Lake has a big park with play areas, watersports and lakeside walks, and it's a great spot to let the kids run around. Xscape in central Milton Keynes has a real indoor snow slope, plus a cinema and plenty of places to eat. Keep an eye out for the city's famous concrete cows, a quirky sculpture from the 1970s that has become a symbol of the town. With all that close by, a weekend in Milton Keynes is easily filled.
